run_panoptic_deeplab_training: run the Panoptic-DeepLab training script with a config file and optional CLI arguments
run_panoptic_deeplab_evaluation: run evaluation only mode on a Panoptic-DeepLab model using saved checkpoint weights
build_trainer_evaluator: build a COCO or Cityscapes panoptic segmentation evaluator for a given dataset and config
build_trainer_train_loader: build a training data loader with PanopticDeepLabDatasetMapper and semantic segmentation augmentations
build_trainer_optimizer: build an SGD or Adam optimizer with gradient clipping from the solver config
